biography.value:
A cheerful Felyne artisan cook who keeps camp meals ready for hunters (Ranks 1–4).

Interact: players double-click this token (within 10 ft) to open the camp kitchen menu — same feel as Gather Resource nodes.

Camp Kitchen Aura (10 ft): PCs in range also get Ask for a Meal as a backup. GM: use Refresh Kitchen Aura once after placing the cook.

Rank locks: Rank 2 at 5th level, Rank 3 at 10th, Rank 4 at 15th (locked tabs stay visible in the menu).

GM: Shift+double-click or Alt+double-click opens the actor sheet. Request Meal can still hand off a complimentary cook-in.

Menus loaded: Ranks 1–4. Daily Skills are inactive templates used for automatic grants.
biography.public: Double-click this Felyne cook for artisan meals at camp (Ranks 1–4).

description.value:
Camp Kitchen Aura (10 ft)

Hunters within 10 feet can double-click the Felyne Cook token to open the camp kitchen menu (Item Piles–style) with Ranks 1–4.

They also gain Ask for a Meal on their sheet as a backup. Leaving the aura removes that feature.

Rank locks follow hunter level: Rank 2 at 5th, Rank 3 at 10th, Rank 4 at 15th.

GM: after placing the cook, use Refresh Kitchen Aura once if PCs are already nearby. Shift+double-click / Alt+double-click opens the cook sheet.

Requires Active Auras for the visual/temp effect. Token interaction arms from the Amellwind module script (or Kitchen Sync).
description.chat: Kitchen aura: double-click the cook token (or Ask) for artisan meals.

description.chatFlavor: Refresh Ask for a Meal grants for hunters within 10 ft.

effects.name: Camp Kitchen Aura (10 ft)
effects.description: You are near the Felyne Cook and can use Ask for a Meal.

macro.name: Camp Kitchen Aura

description.value:
Request Meal — GM handoff

  1. Players: double-click the Felyne Cook token (within 10 ft) to open the camp kitchen menu (Ranks 1–4).
  2. GM (optional): use this activity to hand off a complimentary cook-in to a nearby hunter.
  3. Average three checks vs the meal DC. Success grants the meal feature; +4 / +8 → Daily Skills.
  4. Rank locks: Rank 2 at 5th level, Rank 3 at 10th, Rank 4 at 15th.

Requires MidiQOL + Item Macro. Ask for a Meal remains available as a backup while in the kitchen aura.
description.chat: The Felyne Cook looks for a hunter within 10 feet.

macro.name: Request Meal

description.value:
Ask for a Meal

Preferred: double-click the Felyne Cook token while within 10 feet to open the camp kitchen menu.

This feature is a backup while you remain in the kitchen aura. Request a meal for yourself (1 serving). Higher ranks unlock at character levels 5 / 10 / 15.

Price: Rank 1 2 gp, Rank 2 5 gp, Rank 3 10 gp, Rank 4 20 gp (paid when you confirm the order).

Choose a meal, then assign ability scores to the three cooking steps chosen by the cook.

Granted automatically when you enter the Camp Kitchen Aura.
